instruction: To keep track of my cursor position when editing files, I want the current line to be highlighted. Search the Internet for how to enable cursor line highlighting in Vim and configure it as default.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching for how to enable cursor line highlighting in Vim, then editing ~/.vimrc to add 'set cursorline' or 'set cul'. The evaluator verifies the .vimrc file contains the cursor line highlighting setting.
